sam: Postmortem follow-up we need owners and short ETAs for customer comms: status page line, 72h redacted summary, and RCA sharing rules. Also flag that prefix-cache pressure has appeared multiple times recently and should be mentioned. Proposed owners: @ivy status page, @omar 72h, @claire + @legal RCA policy. Ack + ETA?

ivy: Ack. Ill take the status page. Draft below (short):

ivy: ```
Incident: partial inference degradation for affected requests.
Status: Resolved at 05:50 UTC.
Impact: increased latency and intermittent errors for a subset of requests between 03:2005:50 UTC.
Cause: prefix KV cache pressure (under investigation).
Note: this mirrors prior cache-pressure incidents; were tracking it as a recurring pattern.
Next update: 72-hour redacted summary with remediation steps.
```

omar: Ack. Ill draft 72h redacted summary. Legal: confirm redaction rules (logs/traces/internal hostnames)?

legal: Confirmed  redact PII, raw traces, internal hostnames, tokens. Enterprise customers may request detailed artifacts through secure/account channels.

claire: Comms + CSM: agree with legal. Proposed public RCA sentence: "A redacted RCA will be shared with impacted customers within 72 hours; enterprise customers may request full details via their account team."

sam: Timeline decisions: status page final by tomorrow EOD (ivy), 72h redacted summary by Fri 17:00 UTC (omar), RCA policy language & CSM guidance by Fri COB (claire/legal). Opsbot please create tracker tasks and assign remediation owners for infra/runtime/product.

opsbot: Created INC-5010 "Comms follow-up: status page, 72h summary, RCA policy" assigned to ivy/omar/claire, due 2026-04-22. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-5010

sam: Thanks all. If any blockers, prefix with "blocker:" so we can escalate quickly. :thumbsup:
